Finite tests only corroborate the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An objectively minimal graph perturbation (one vertex added to a balanced third part) changes the unbiased primitive-two attraction probability from a vanishing \(O(n^{-1/2})\) law to a nonzero 1/6 law; the exact finite census quantifies attraction to an exponentially sparse core. The ratio-dependent strictly increasing arcsine curve identifies a natural macroscopic family of asymptotic phases. Neither a period upper bound nor a recurrent-orbit count supplies this basin information.
